name: Skill Curator
description: Autonomous skill library lifecycle management. Periodically reviews agent-created skills, transitions stale skills (30d unused) and archives long-dormant ones (90d). Injects audit guidance after idle periods. Never auto-deletes — only archives. Ported from hermes-agent/agent/curator.py.

staleAfterDays.description: Mark a skill stale after N days without use (default: 30)

archiveAfterDays.description: Move stale skill to .archive/ after N days (default: 90)
